Each correction: our verse with the tokens LORD/Lord/GOD/God re-cased to the second KJV witness, applied only where the WEB oracle (Yahweh=LORD/GOD, Lord=Lord) agrees with that witness (OT), or where the NT convention (LORD only inside OT quotations of the Name) and the second witness agree (NT). The adversary-name lowercasing of #1397 is a directive and is untouched.
